init_OpenAIChat: initialize an OpenAIChat instance with a DictConfig containing generation parameters and Azure OpenAI credentials
generate_with_OpenAIChat: generate a text response from a prompt using the OpenAIChat generate method with optional stop and max_length
generate_multimodal_with_OpenAIChat: generate a response from a multimodal prompt containing text and image URLs using OpenAIChat
generate_message_convert: convert a multimodal prompt list into an OpenAI formatted message dict with text and image_url content
validate_conf_OpenAIChat: validate the OpenAIChat configuration to ensure streaming is disabled before generation
